message.content:
Hydrocortisone sodium succinate injection in dosage form falls in heading 3004 (medicaments in measured doses), and subheading 3004.32 covers medicaments containing corticosteroid hormones, their derivatives or structural analogues.

The statistical suffixes under 3004.32 are:
- 3004.32.00 is the 8-digit subheading, "Containing hormones or other products of heading 2937, but not containing antibiotics: containing corticosteroid hormones, their derivatives or structural analogues."
- 3004.32.0010 is "Dexamethasone".
- 3004.32.0020 is "Hydrocortisone".
- 3004.32.0030 is "Prednisolone".
- 3004.32.0090 is "Other".

I recall hydrocortisone being listed with its own suffix, but I am not fully certain of the exact suffix numbers, so this is the best match from memory. Hydrocortisone sodium succinate is a hydrocortisone derivative, so I chose the hydrocortisone line, 3004.32.0020.

{"hts_code": "3004.32.0020", "reason": "Hydrocortisone sodium succinate injection is a corticosteroid medicament put up in measured doses, classified in subheading 3004.32 under the hydrocortisone statistical line."}
